The signing bonus is generous. He is reluctant to leave you, and you'd be reluctant to lose a valuable soldier, but he'd be in a fine position to sing your praises.

IL_7a62: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_7a68: ldstr          {=0awbcZag}Give him your blessing and encourage him to bore everyone to tears with his old war stories.
IL_7ab4: ldstr          {=Qb3axqdZ}Persuade him to stay. The arena is fine for practice but true glory is not won with blunted weapons.
IL_7ae9: ldstr          {=klVc5afL}Let him go if he splits his signing bonus with you.

IL_7b69: ldstr          {=GgYzaakh}Trade in {TOWN_NAME} has been booming, and prices and wages have been going up. The workers at your {WORKSHOP} have taken notice. Your superviser reports that they have all refused to come in to work until they receive a pay increase. He notes that there remain plenty of hungry mouths and willing hands in town, but that the current workers might cause trouble if they are replaced.

IL_7b8b: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_7b91: ldstr          {=5krpAZu6}Chide them gently for walking off the job before coming to you first, because of course you'll up their wages.
IL_7bd4: ldstr          {=zM2vbhrt}Sit down with them and negotiate a mutual understanding.
IL_7c13: ldstr          {=aTU2CgIU}Fire the lot of them, hire different workers, and post some troops outside to protect your shop.

IL_7c9c: ldstr          {=Eih6lrcN}Business is good at your {WORKSHOP} in {TOWN}, but in the rush to keep up with demand the normal precautions are not being taken. {INJURY_TEXT} He will live, but is unlikely to be able to do skilled work, and the rest of the workers are worried about future accidents.

IL_7cbe: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_7cc4: ldstr          {=JdlbkM8C}Pay him a pension and order your supervisors to take more care, even if it slows down production.
IL_7d40: ldstr          {=OlvD0u1O}You're not going to pay for another man's clumsiness. Let work recommence at the same pace.
IL_7d8f: ldstr          {=k4aNfNHg}As on the battlefield, so on the workshop floor. Let each team work at its own pace, receiving bonuses for output, but also taking responsibiliy for injuries.

IL_7dee: ldstr          {=82Fno8Vr}Your clerk at your {WORKSHOP} in {TOWN} has caught one of your foremen skimming from the funds you use to purchase raw materials. Luckily, he did not take much, and he readily confessed. How do you prevent this from happening in the future?

IL_7e10: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)

IL_7e16: ldstr          {=47hUs9yg}You make an example of the foreman. You hand him over to the town authorities and encourage them to apply the full penalty - branding as a thief and exile from the town.
IL_7e72: ldstr          {=n2mOvIPt}You appeal to your men's better natures. You plea for leniency for your foreman, and beg them not to take advantage.
IL_7eb2: ldstr          {=cyZG4qHm}You institute a complex scheme of bookkeeping, even though it will make purchases more onerous and slow down production.
IL_7ef1: ldstr          {=G8eaX10B}You treat all your workers as potential thieves, having them searched coming and going from the workshop.

IL_7f1f: ldstr          {=cJdoDJ4M}One prominent resident of {TOWN}, {ARTISAN_NAME}, approaches you. Your {WORKSHOP} has been hiring workers who have recently migrated in from the countryside. He requests that you fire them and take on some local boys from the back alleys. If you refuse, he won't be responsible if the carts carrying your shipments get swarmed by traffic going through tight gates, slowing down production.

IL_7f41: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_7f47: ldstr          {=bdUzdzIe}Sadly bid farewell to the migrants and wish them well in future endeavors.
IL_7f84: ldstr          {=qoSObD62}Tell {ARTISAN_NAME} to do his worst - you're not firing men who've served you well.
IL_7fce: ldstr          {=TbF5Kc4x}Ask {ARTISAN_NAME} if you can make a sizeable contribution to his guild's feast and funeral fund.

IL_805c: ldstr          {=pNVKWAKo}Throughout your visit to {VILLAGE}, one of your older {TROOP_TYPE} seems moody and downcast. As you march out, he suddenly stops, stares at a roadside stall, then breaks ranks from your party and starts shouting at the vendor. The story quickly comes tumbling out. He served in one of the Empire's old legions in a battle here against the {NEAREST_OTHER_CULTURE}, and the vendor is selling scraps of metal that were clearly looted from the graves of the dead.

IL_8079: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)

IL_807f: ldstr          {=N2Sb9nS6}Purchase what old helmets and shield bosses you can and allow your man to build a small memorial on the battlefield, even though you know it will soon be looted afresh.
IL_80d8: ldstr          {=fqBRonK9}Do you not also not loot whatever you can from the dead at your victories? Tell your man to save his anger for wrongs done to the living.
IL_810d: ldstr          {=WGmKib15}Erupt in fury at the vendor and accuse him of grave desecration. It's unlikely that the thefts will stop, but your men will be pleased.

IL_8189: ldstr          {=Jo5OjwAU}Your men fought truly heroically in the last battle. As they help their wounded comrades back to camp and gather the slain, their weary faces sometimes look to you with expectation. If ever there was a time to give them some extra recognition of their valor and sacrifice, this would be it.

IL_81ba: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_81c0: ldstr          {=Wenvx1OE}Reach into your treasury and grab great fistfuls of silver denars, hurling it to your men and praising them by name for their deeds.
IL_8233: ldstr          {=w3a39PVT}Give them an extra week's pay as a bonus, telling them they deserve far more but it is all you can afford.
IL_8280: ldstr          {=WnlD7awi}Gruffly tell them that you were pleased they did their duty.

IL_82ae: ldstr          {=D7ZcX8XR}As you pass through the market, {NOTABLE.NAME} requests a minute of your time. {?NOTABLE.GENDER}Her{?}His{\?} cousin is planning on doing some business in {TOWN}, and {?NOTABLE.GENDER}she{?}he{\?} would like a letter of reference from you. You know next to nothing about the lad, although {NOTABLE.NAME} swears that he is honest and conscientious. You find you are receiving a number of these types of requests as your fame spreads.

IL_82cc: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_82d2: ldstr          {=z15Ux7sh}Write truthfully that you don't know much about the bearer of the letter, but he comes from good family.
IL_82f6: ldstr          {=aZwaFhA6}Write effusively about the lad's qualities.
IL_8345: ldstr          {=8rEX8rjv}Tell {NOTABLE.NAME} that you will write whatever {?NOTABLE.GENDER}she{?}he{\?} wants, for the proper price.
IL_839d: ldstr          {=DOPdMPla}Upbraid {NOTABLE.NAME} in the street for all to hear for daring to presume that you would recommend anyone that you do not know.
IL_83ff: ldstr          {=OqlihYNW}The Tiller and the Wanderer

IL_8404: ldstr          {=nuqL3OAF}As you are leaving your fief you stumble across an altercation. A group of nomads, who pass by annually on their migration from summer to winter pastures, have allowed their herds to graze in your tenants' crops. Your troops far outnumber the nomads and your tenants are urging you to teach them a lesson, but of course their kin might retaliate at a later date.

IL_8435: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_843b: ldstr          {=fI8Bd468}Seize the nomads' herds to compensate you and your tenants for their crops.
IL_8566: ldstr          {=ciQPfxEC}Demand that the nomads pay fair compensation for damaged crops, even though you know this will not settle the problem for long.
IL_85e1: ldstr          {=fkQj3TIP}Tell the nomads that proud warriors such as themselves need not worry what these dirt-diggers think. Share a meal with them, and see if some will join you.

IL_8695: ldstr          {=SAXnFQLq}The people of {VILLAGE_NAME} warned you to take care outside their village. When the mist gathers, The woods will be haunted by spirits whose shriek foretells death. Now the gloom is gathering, and you hear mutterings from your men. You are certain that they will soon be hearing wailing and seeing apparitions, real or imagined. The horses are becoming twitchy too, picking up on the mood of the men, and accidents are likely to happen.

IL_86c6: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_86cc: ldstr          {=uD05twgi}Tell your men to ignore the superstitions of villagers, and press on.
IL_8765: ldstr          {=BxpJKMYq}Dispel the spirits in the approved orthodox Calradian way, by loudly calling on Heaven to ward off the ghosts of Below.
IL_879a: ldstr          {=4Ef7xG1o}Propitiate the spirits as the villagers advised, by slaughtering a black cockerel that they sold one of your men.

IL_87da: ldstr          {=D9T64ejr}As you leave {VILLAGE_NAME}, several of the villagers approach you. They warn you that stagnant ponds from the last rain have yet to fully dry and have bred mosquitos. They offer to sell you a concoction of oils including rosemary, catmint and other herbs that they say will ward off all flying vermin.

IL_880a: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_8810: ldstr          {=zGVNqFnh}Buy vials of ointment for every member of your party, at the risk of looking gullible.
IL_8870: ldstr          {=qCoqaa70}Have your men wrap themselves up as best they can and press on.
IL_8893: ldstr          {=VccCV5dX}Take circuitous routs to avoid the ponds.

IL_88cc: ldstr          {=WR7NCetE}As you leave {VILLAGE_NAME}, a scraggly young man waves to attract your attention. He leads a magnificent {RARE_HORSE}, and says that he will sell it to you for a mere 500 denars. He claims he found it wandering on a heath, almost dead from exhaustion and neglect, and he nursed it back to health. He won't go into town because he says he would be unfairly accused of theft.

IL_88e9: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_88ef: ldstr          {=YVETzHXK}Plausible enough, and you have no time to check the provenance of every bargain you find. Buy the horse!
IL_8973: ldstr          {=B9HD9PNw}A likely story... Place the man under arrest and send word to the authorities of {TOWN_NAME}, who have the time to sort things out.
IL_89d2: ldstr          {=CyM5bAdB}You're not sure you trust the seller, but you're not handing over to officials who might just hang him and seize the horse themselves. Go on your way.
IL_89f5: ldstr          {=AwBJzppu}Take the horse without paying. Tell the seller that thieves have no right to complain of theft.

IL_8a6b: ldstr          {=th5MgyAZ}As you enter {TOWN_NAME}, one of your {ASERAI_TROOPS} approaches you. Many of his comrades are not used to the heat of the desert, he says. They march after drinking wine through the evening but are not careful to properly take water throughout the day, as the sun beats down on them. He has seen men collapse and die from such carelessness and ignorance.

IL_8a8c: call           TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour.RegisterIncident(System.String, System.String, System.String, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentTrigger, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.IncidentsCampaignBehaviour+IncidentType, TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignTime, System.Func<TaleWorlds.Localization.TextObject, System.Boolean>)
IL_8a92: ldstr          {=lbSsRg8w}Your men will resent any curbs on their celebrations, even for their own health. Warn them but take no other precautions.
IL_8ac6: ldstr          {=3Uub2e17}Tell your men that there shall be no wine tonight, and none henceforth until they learn how to handle themselves in the desert.
IL_8ae9: ldstr          {=cG9pkbqo}Let them men celebrate, but move slowly in the morning, pausing to make sure that each man is drinking from his water-skin.

methods.signature: System.Void TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.CampaignBehaviors.ItemConsumptionBehavior.MakeConsumption(TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem.Settlements.Town town, System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<TaleWorlds.Core.ItemCategory, System.Single> categoryDemand, System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<TaleWorlds.Core.ItemCategory, System.Int32> saleLog)

{=7V5SbkQ2}Well... Thank you very much. I am grateful.
{=NmGJs7yB}My name is {PLAYER.NAME}, {?CONVERSATION_NPC.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}. May I ask your name?
{=PtDgM4Xo}They know me as {PLAYER.NAME}. Mark it down, you shall be hearing of me a lot.
{=cCYHPyit}I have decided to free you. You may go.

string_literals: {=!}(CHEAT) How do you feel about other lords?
{=!}(CHEAT) Tell me about the enmities in your faction..
{=!}(CHEAT) Tell me about your personal reputation
{=!}(TEST CHEAT) What do you want to know?
{=!}What are you and your men doing? (v1)
{=!}Why, I'd be delighted to tell you!
{=1OU1ZkaZ}{SALUTATION_BY_PLAYER}, I wish to be more than a mercenary. Is there a way I could pledge myself as a vassal?
{=201kVrNa}{SALUTATION_BY_PLAYER}, I wish to be released from my oath to you.
{=3INC3Thi}If you need me, you know where to find me.
{=3WA4MLzx}One way or the other, you'll regret this. If I fall, my people will have their revenge.[if:idle_angry][ib:warrior]
{=3ZL6El0S}Very well, my lady. I hope we shall meet again soon.
{=4NYPsxgY}I need to leave. Good-bye, for now.
{=4mqtjf3y}Farewell. The righteous need fear no storm, for the Heavens shall protect them.
{=5ANh9qVW}Farewell for now. Walk the path of the righteous, and the Heavens will protect you.
{=70s1eahS}Hmf. I am amused. So amused that I might have to cut out your tongue after the battle and keep it to remind me of your wit.[if:idle_angry][ib:warrior]
{=8dMkj1qK}I'll be looking you up again soon, m'lady, with your permission,
{=8xvSu9fX}Forgive me {?CONVERSATION_NPC.GENDER}madame{?}sir{\?}. I don't know what I was thinking.
{=9804jwU1}It was a pleasure, sir. I hope to see you again some time soon.
{=9d3tffnL}We do not need hired swords to win this war. You should seek your fortune elsewhere.
{=AypnUIky}Well, I am disappointed, but I am sure that you will have many chances to redeem yourself.[ib:closed][if:convo_bored]
{=AzmriKR8}I have hardly heard of you, {PLAYER.NAME}. Go fight a few bandits, make a name for yourself. Then we can talk.
{=B2z3mEue}Actually, I was going to talk about something else.
{=BYuzbj3L}Farewell, my husband. Safe travels, and a swift return.
{=CVClzSC7}I believe you have already pledged yourself to another liege.
{=EBI3j6O8}Sure. You know where to find me.
{=EK3dEjBv}I must say, my lady, I am indeed delighted to have met you. I hope to see you again soon.
{=F9LlA26R}Actually, I think you're the one who ought to surrender.
{=FMJuPZlm}I'm not surrendering, so do what you must.[if:idle_angry][ib:warrior]
{=FREVkpWP}I might be willing to pay for passage.
{=H715sxmf}That is lower than what I had in mind. Let me think about it.
{=HCF4xGfk}Right... Well, you be off, then. Keep safe.
{=HEJOdRwi}Forgive me, {?CONVERSATION_NPC.GENDER}madame{?}sir{\?}. I don't know what I was thinking.
{=HKMdHYb7}I stand my ground. Prepare to fight!
{=Ht3S4nvm}Let's do some diagnostics about your faction.
{=J6UU9cfU}Very well, my dear. I hope we can soon sort out the terms of our marriage.
{=JTt3Xu9t}Our kingdom is not at war, {PLAYER.NAME}. We have no use for mercenaries.
{=JWjBnGST}I am afraid I won't be able to do this quest.
{=Kfbqriuh}I heard you may need some help with a problem?
{=NOH4FilQ}I have no task to offer you right now.
{=O3BqrO85}So long as the denars keep flowing, so will the blood of your enemies.
{=OB37sx91}Don't be a stranger, eh? Come see me again some time.
{=OlKbD2fa}I can use someone like you in my company.
{=PitXi5n6}You know we are at war. Surrender or die.
{=QLbyXqiV}Can I talk to one of your prisoners?
{=QffdjUxf}Very well. I'll get my gear and join you outside.
{=Qm6SGjkb}Farewell, my wife. Safe travels, and a swift return.
{=St6NxphR}Be my guest, who would you like to talk to?
{=TWSRs4gz}Farewell, my lady. I shall remain your most ardent admirer.
{=V5Kygicn}It was good to meet you. Come see me if you need anything.
{=VbUnP1M5}Very well. For now, go in peace.
{=VrnlUvV8}I'm here to deliver you my demands!
{=VvxGEJoz}I am enchanted to have met you, my lady.
{=Wuxn9sDq}My sword is yours. For the right sum.
{=XD7xYD0U}I want you to join my army. ({INFLUENCE_COST}{INFLUENCE_ICON})
{=ZG6kWWwW}I'm not yielding, so let's go to it, then.[if:idle_angry][ib:warrior]
{=ZnZAPDMo}So be it. You may ply your wit on the carrion-fowl.[if:idle_angry][ib:warrior]
{=afdN8ZU7}Thinking again, I already have more companions than I can manage.
{=ahbhSL6B}Farewell then, and perhaps if the seas are kind we shall meet again.
{=dLQDe7mj}I was thinking of a different prisoner
{=dSSphiFs}We do not need hired swords currently because we are not at war. You should seek your fortune elsewhere.
{=ddMn72IL}Farewell. I wish you fair winds and following seas.
{=gZSdus34}I offer you one chance to surrender or die.
{=hBFHcNaz}Come see me again soon, {PLAYER.NAME}, you hear?
{=hfbyHRu7}Farewell. If no one slits your throat out there, perhaps we shall meet again.
{=iIlnWsBE}Keep safe, {PLAYER.NAME}. I hope to see you again soon.
{=jBN2LlgF}We'll fight to our last drop of blood!
{=kJDDW6Dk}It was a pleasure to meet you. Safe travels.
{=ksRC6ZmC}Right. Clear the way, then, and try not to cut our wind.
{=lord_conversations_343}There is something I'd like to discuss.
{=lord_conversations_344}I have a proposal that may spare us both unnecessary bloodshed.
{=lord_conversations_345}Stay your hand! Perhaps we don't have to come to blows.
{=ltS8zmH8}Are you mad? I'm not your enemy.
{=m0ybQ1Gz}You can count on me. As of now, your enemies are my enemies and your honor is my honor.
{=meVKYu9a}{SALUTATION_BY_PLAYER}, I would pledge allegiance to you and be counted among your loyal followers.
{=nePa28Sb}Very good, then. Be on your way.
{=oiMs17Oh}Very well... You know where to find me.
{=pHXMp2bR}Fine. We'll hoist sail and be on our way, then.
{=rl7rSDEk}Good. The wind is with us, so I'd rather not waste any more time.
{=sy5Hbp04}Safe travels to you, my lady. I hope to see you again soon.
{=thxkhXmR}Very well. When next we meet, I can't promise things will go so peacefully.
{=uvlaEOg0}Very well. We'll be on our way then, as there is not a moment to be lost. Farewell.
{=wCMNQsBu}I will put in a word about you to {KING.LINK}.
{=wxK1bTZm}Do think about it. But make sure you do not end up on the losing side.
{=yUYNlQhU}Good, I'll have my men write up a simple contract. On behalf of the {KINGDOM_FORMAL_NAME}, I welcome you. May you put your sword to good use against our enemies.
{=zG5jo0bJ}Yes, have you made any progress on it?
{=zJVb2aCe}Farewell, {PLAYER.NAME}. I regret that we part on these terms.

string_literals: {=0wTZx8EC}You don't seem trustworthy. I have no interest in your offer.
{=22LCyCoA}I can offer your realm {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON} to declare war on the {KINGDOM_TO_CALL_TO_WAR_AGAINST}.
{=3L8xN9uC}I believe it hasn't been long since we've last bartered.
{=6eHl9Tz4}I would like you to serve {PLAYER_FACTION} as mercenary.
{=6po3wjFa}Okay. I hope you will not regret this.
{=7Qr1yZhJ}So be it. Come see me again if you want to arrange a new one.
{=9QulsaxG}Do you have any general thoughts on politics?
{=BbbBqKUs}You don't have the money to hire us.
{=CuFvVPNt}I have a proposal that may benefit us both.
{=D9Rl5jyS}I was thinking of a different kingdom.
{=EN9s6oZz}Very well. As you're paid for each battle, not for a fixed period of time, you can end it whenever you like.
{=LVX2x6Jf}I would like to end my contract with the {SERVED_FACTION}.
{=Mwlr0aJO}We can consider it, assuming that you are willing to offset the costs. Who did you have in mind?
{=VIztLFNQ}You need to discuss this with our leader {LEADER.LINK}.
{=VJbQNVDu}You don't deserve my coin. This contract is over.
{=Xpekpwby}Barter line - player should not see this
{=Z27lsnCO}Well. Let me put things this way...
{=ZmezmQST}As your allies, we would request your assistance against one of our enemies.
{=aIbR4Nr3}Sure, but first you will need to pay me and my men {GOLD_AMOUNT} denars for our efforts.
{=ao7gZafg}Very well. We will come with you.
{=dfEi6GSE}We will fight for you if you can afford our fee. Please have a look at our terms and see if they are acceptable.
{=zFAkHQRH}I am ready to pay my debt.

string_literals: {=5z4hEq68}I am thinking of a different kind of workshop.
{=8d7y1IHp}All right. Just to confirm - {.%}{.a} {WORKSHOP_TYPE}{.%} is what you want?
{=9eLyeU7M}Sure, boss. It will cost us {COST}{GOLD_ICON} for new equipment. Shall we go ahead?
{=DBTOhVl0}I'm glad you reconsidered, boss. Maybe it's not my place to say, but I think you should never let go of a good investment.
{=EPb2BDuo}We had a good run, boss. Maybe we can work together again in the future. For now, it will take some time to pack things up.
{=Imes09et}Okay, then. We'll take that silver and buy some tools and and hire some workers with the proper skills.
{=QHbcFrPX}On second thought, I don't want to change what we are producing. Go on like this.
{=QKsaPj6w}We take raw materials and produce goods and sell them at the local market. After paying the workers their wages we transfer the profits to the owner.
{=VO8qBWrv}Hey boss, come to check on the business?
{=WAa4yaTo}What do you want us to make?
{=XQa48r6e}If you say so, boss. So, if I sell everything and transfer you the money we have on hand, you can get {PRICE}{GOLD_ICON}. You sure you want to sell?
{=XZgD99ol}Anything else I can do for you?
{=b92969l9}I would like to change what you are producing here.
{=eemYX2d4}I will transfer the goods from your warehouse to your party immediately.
{=icmr0jSa}This workshop belongs to {OWNER.LINK}. You need to talk to {?OWNER.GENDER}her{?}him{\?}.
{=p3a44dQN}I would like to buy this workshop.
{=qGIFpahv}Can't spare any coins for you. Sorry. May Heaven provide.
{=rXbL9mhQ}I want to talk about other things.
{=uotflvH2}I would like to ask some questions.
{=z3BeN9ro}I would like to sell this workshop.

string_literals: {=00bd3Huo}performing new rituals that treat the ruler as semi-divine
{=0Qh7Pa9E}Tenants are forbidden from leaving the lands of their lords without notice.
{=0wxRZ9AV}Armies led by Tier 5+ nobles require 10% less influence{newline}Influence of the ruler clan is reduced by 1 per day
{=1Y5p40uP}granting villagers the right to graze on land held in common
{=2Qx4bL66}The ruler has a monopoly on certain goods, although practically he can license out production to merchants and collect a portion of the proceeds.

{=55CsWKbg}Some kingdoms, especially those that evolved from a city-state or a tribe, had popular assemblies that most of its members had the right to attend. Its powers were often limited, since it could only meet periodically, but it still gave the public the right to participate in government.
{=5WR5DsOz}Rulers could make money fast by debasing the currency and minting more, but this would cause prices to rise.
{=5Wld45hP}forbidding tenants from leaving their lords' lands
{=6DQjKwt2}The influence cost of proposing settlement annexation is reduced by 50% for the ruler clan
{=6kn630ka}Ruler clan gains 100 denars per day for each town in the kingdom{newline}Settlement loyalty is decreased by 1 per day
{=76TgEba5}letting the ruler collect extra taxes in wartime
{=7EP0NgzU}The highest ranking of nobles have the de facto right to assemble large armies.
{=7kNxogN8}appointing independent elders to uphold the law
{=8qwvZ15E}Towns held by the ruler clan gain 1 Loyalty and 1 Prosperity per day{newline}Towns held by non-ruler clans lose 0.3 Loyalty per day
{=9YKV4SNH}restricting what creditor may do to collect debts
{=AlFTInfU}States with strict and formal laws of inheritance make it more difficult to revoke land.
{=AzKq8AfI}In theory, the king or the emperor has the sole right to command men in the field. Anyone commanding an army does so in the king's name.
{=D3W9Qi0Z}All lords have a formal role on the council.
{=DG3JbOa2}For kingdom decisions, the influence cost of the ruler overriding the popular decision outcome is reduced by 20%
{=DIQF5bAX}giving the state monopolies on key goods
{=EG06bDxi}granting awards for deeds in the field
{=FMUlfbJf}Rulers organize farmers into groups of households responsible for supplying troops. This makes recruiting easier, but at the cost of their economic productivity.
{=GFnqIuxy}encouraging lords to appoint bailiffs in their fiefs
{=GwAZMQ8b}Ruler's party size is increased by 60{newline}Non-ruling clans lose 0.2 influence per day.
{=H9Px95rR}Villages grant 0.2 influence per day to the owner clan{newline}Towns gain 1 security but lose 1 militia per day
{=HQGUoRTW}The ruler is considered semi-divine and certain rituals are to be performed in his or her presence, increasing his or her air of authority.

{=InFseOAA}This limits the ability of magistrates to condemn those they consider criminals quickly. It prevents arbitrary abuse of power, but landowners or gang leaders can sometimes use threats or bribes to manipulate it.
{=L9aNOiJo}granting those accused of major crimes the right to trial by jury

{=L9n6yu1X}The influence cost of creating an army is reduced by 30% for the ruler{newline}Armies led by the ruler earn cohesion at 30% less cost{newline}Armies led by non-ruler nobles cost 10% more influence to create
{=LIjN3rYD}Tier 5+ clans lose 1 influence per day and the party size of their leaders is increased by 40

{=Lgmisw4L}This reform limits the degree to which lords and merchants can lend to their tenants and employees and then demand repayment, or seize their assets or their freedom. It effectively bans serfdom.
{=LpdAa1NY}Tier 5+ clans gain 0.5 influence per day, influence cost of inviting lower tier clans to army are increased by 20%

{=MF40cm9k}Land grants are considered to be temporary offices rather than the rightful inheritance of lords. In practice heirs tend to take over their family fiefs, but it's easier under Depositions to remove them.
{=MWvzJSH1}A shift in the tax system that put more emphasis on property and less on the head tax charged to everyone could collect more from wealthy landowners.
{=O4iki0FD}Ruler gains 5% tax from all settlements{newline}Towns lose 1 prosperity per day{newline}The influence cost of declaring war is doubled for the ruler clan

{=O5sBO9sQ}Many empires granted their populations citizenship, which usually came with a series of rights. Of course, citizenship could not be granted immediately to conquered provinces until the population showed it was willing to adopt the ways of the empire, including its language, clothes, and religious cults.
{=OWwPj500}5% of the village income is paid to the ruler clan as tax{newline}5% less village income for clans
{=PG8anNca}Settlement loyalty is increased by 0.5 per day{newline}Daily hearth production at villages decreases by 0.25 per day
{=QLNfsk93}Town security is increased by 1 per day{newline}Town taxes are reduced by 5%
{=QlZc9CNQ}Rulers could appoint magistrates to rule in disputes and solve crimes. This could cut down on gang activity and lawlessness, but was often greatly resented by communities.
{=QoubP07U}allowing the ruler to grant special privileges to towns
{=RbjN7VQ2}Ruler clan earns 3 influence per day{newline}Non-ruler clans lose 0.5 influence per day
{=TsvBHBdX}Tier 3+ clans gain 0.5 influence per day, influence cost of inviting lower tier clans to army are increased by 10%
{=U7s1LycQ}This refers to the practice of appointing independent elders to remind the council of the law and past precedents. It allows commoners without education to make complex legal arguments.
{=UZ0mPm8b}Each notable yields 0.1 influence per day to the settlement's owner clan{newline}Tax from fortifications 5% decreased
{=Vl8BHCvF}allowing the ruler to easily revoke fiefs

{=VzmzX9Ln}This revives the tribunate, an institution in ancient oligarchic republics that gave representation to families without patrician standing. These elected officers could veto legislation from the more aristocratic Senate.
{=W3xUQxAa}encouraging lords to have large private armies
{=XFcmlN1J}Town security is increased by 1 per day{newline}Towns with a security greater than 60 yield 1 additional influence to the owner clan.{newline}Tax from towns are reduced by 5%
{=YOBeOFxY}Town taxes paid to the ruler are reduced by 5%{newline}Town loyalty is increased by 1 per day
{=ZJ2tJnJk}Settlement loyalty is increased by 0.5 per day{newline}Settlement security is decreased by 0.2 per day{newline}Clans lose 1 influence per day
{=ZMTkq5TG}Nobles and other landowners have exclusive rights to hunt in forests.
{=aKLak7nn}giving the ruler broader powers to veto laws
{=aWWzrwAw}The cost of revoking a fief from a clan is doubled{newline}Clans gain 0.1 influence for each fief they own

{=aaUeq1dp}Veterans of the realm's armies are allowed to claim abandoned farmland and receive reduced taxes under the expectation that they will train their children and fellow villagers for future military service.
{=agaSYd5t}Food production in towns and castles are increased by 2{newline}Town loyalty is decreased by 0.2
{=auftprN9}allowing the common people to elect tribes to represent them
{=b4TeiuoJ}Exceptional taxes were often applied in wartime.
{=bDANTRwA}5% tax on tariffs is paid to the ruler clan{newline}Higher trade penalty in towns{newline}Town prosperity is decreased by 1 per day
{=bFEdxs6Y}All clans whose leader has high Charm gain 1 influence per day{newline}All clans whose leader has low Charm lose 1 influence per day
{=bPpdw81a}Daily militia production is increased by 1{newline}Recruits replenish 20% faster{newline}Tax income in settlements are reduced by 10%
{=bhoCBIWB}authorizing the ruler to have a large private bodyguard
{=bxWITUaN}having the greatest lords of the realm meet as a small privy council
{=cBAVR7e8}granting high-ranking nobles the right to summon large armies
{=ceq6ZMIx}Lords can vote to award each other decorations and distinctions for battlefield achievements, allowing them greater opportunities to share military glory with the ruler.
{=dLkfbU0a}Trade tax paid to the town owner is increased by 3%{newline}Town prosperity is decreased by 0.2
{=dvEkfaab}recognizing the common folk in the realm as full citizens
{=eibt105C}The ruler maintains a prestigious personal guard. It attracts warriors who might otherwise serve their local lord.
{=elvb5y2I}The ruler is allowed to impose special taxes on trade in towns, payable directly to the royal or imperial treasury.

{=fjj0pJXV}Landowners could often assert legal rights to common areas and charge villages money to use them. If ordinary people petitioned a ruler, however, he might give them the right to use all common areas for hunting or grazing as members of the village.
{=gOn7a7if}granting lords exclusive hunting rights to nearby forests
{=ieIWHAtc}A ruler can grant towns special privileges based on their 'immediacy', special access to his person without going through lords or other vassals.
{=ifnnu3g4}There is a long list of reasons why a ruler can reject a law passed by the council. A ruler does not need to search long to find an excuse for a veto.
{=kIVfA5cv}Ruler clan gains 5% of settlement as tax per town{newline}Workshop production is decreased by 10%
{=kPqs7EIf}giving the ruler more power to summon armies
{=lXSeaba5}having the lords of the realm meet as a permanent council
{=nP7KOISK}Local landowners have the right to collect tolls on commerce.
{=nmnp9S7k}Nobles have the right to appoint bailiffs.
{=on2EmlUT}A small council of the greatest lords of the realm. This gives the main clans extra influence, but prevents other clans from climbing into their ranks.

{=qEOXka0Q}+0.5 Loyalty per day to settlements that have the same culture as their owner clan{newline}Settlement militia production is increased by 1{newline}-0.5 Loyalty per day to settlements with a different culture than its owner clan
{=srByX06Y}letting all citizens meet and vote on some issues
{=t8TfagYL}Nobles are encouraged to fortify their estates, and can requisition labor and materials to do so.
{=uCXGZ2YP}Military achievements grant 20% more influence{newline}Troop wages are increased by 10%
{=upK62aLR}allowing lords tolls on roads running through their lands
{=w3GIUD3u}allowing the ruler to collect special tariffs
{=waWOKitN}Offering state-owned land to those who served for years in the armies of the realm.
{=xJ2uDcob}Settlement loyalty is increased by 2 per day{newline}Settlement production is reduced by 5%
{=yXb8bphB}Nobles are expected to raise sizable retinues.
{=zKtJHYuI}Settlement militia veterancy increased by +10%{newline}Village tax income -5%
